name: fishertimer

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile app up -d --build
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile app down
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile app down -v
scripts.k8s:apply: kubectl kustomize --load-restrictor LoadRestrictionsNone k8s | kubectl --context kind-fishertimer apply -f -
scripts.k8s:traefik: kubectl --context kind-fishertimer apply --server-side -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.6.3/standard-install.yaml && helm upgrade --install traefik traefik --repo https://traefik.github.io/charts --version 42.1.2 --namespace traefik --create-namespace --kube-context kind-fishertimer --values k8s/traefik-values.yaml --wait

description: Fisher Timer - Community Study Timer & Gamified Focus Monorepo
